summary: Frontend-only verification of new refinements: Whyst0 zero-font on output, centered column pairs, ASTEO header letter-spacing. Tested BOTH surfaces. (1) STANDALONE offline (all external network aborted except document+data:): after `document.fonts.ready` + explicit `document.fonts.load('12px Whyst0')`, document.fonts.check('12px Whyst0')=true, check('11px TicketMono')=true, check('700 11px TicketMono')=true. window.jspdf.jsPDF and window.html2canvas defined. No pageerror. NOTE: on initial page load the Whyst0 face status is 'unloaded' until first use/explicit load — expected for font-display:swap with data: src; check returns true once loaded. (2) STANDALONE CSS: `.z0 { font-family: Whyst0, TicketMono, monospace; font-weight: 400; }` rule present; scripts include wrapZeros() and z0 class references. (3) STANDALONE header .hdr: text '***\u00a0\u00a0\u00a0\u00a0\u00a0ASTEO\u00a0\u00a0\u00a0\u00a0\u00a0***', computed letter-spacing = 4px (>=3px). (4) STANDALONE overflow: filled #provenance='89638 YEO FRAIS 23 AV DE FONDEYRE TOULOUSE', #nCamion='HK-319-GA', #poidsNet='9 400' -> zero descendants exceed ticket right (ticketRight=938, offenders=0). (5) STANDALONE columns centered: three .two/.inl rows measured -> lastRight vs ticketRight gaps = 15.5, 47, 12 px -- all rightmost items are well within ticket.right - 10px, confirming centered pairs (not flush right). (6) STANDALONE PDF export: button.primary -> valid %PDF (4.30MB) downloaded. Adding 5 tickets via button.green + re-export -> valid multi-page %PDF (MediaBox count = 3). button.blue click triggers print msg (shows 'Préparation de l'impression…' immediately; then transitions to '✓ Impression envoyée' — captured mid-animation this run, previous iterations captured the final text). (7) REACT root: [data-testid=ticket-document] mounted; no pageerror. document.fonts.check for Whyst0, Roboto Mono 400, Roboto Mono 700 all true. .tk-zero span count=14; sampled spans have textContent='0' and computed font-family = 'Whyst0, "Roboto Mono", monospace' (starts with Whyst0). .tk-hdr letter-spacing=4px. Long provenance + HK-319-GA nCamion -> zero overflow offenders (ticketRight=938, offenders=0). save-pdf-button -> valid %PDF (1.91MB) with MediaBox present. Screenshot visually confirms the '0' in '31021 TOULOUSE CEDEX 2' rendered in Whyst Wide (looks like uppercase-O shape) - Whyst0 font actively applied to zeros in the non-editable output.
critical_code_review_comments: Whyst0 @font-face uses data: src which starts as 'unloaded' until first use; document.fonts.check may return false immediately after DOMContentLoaded. This is a race-condition trap for tests but not a runtime bug — the html2canvas capture and rendered zeros properly force load. Consider preloading via a hidden element or FontFace.load() in a load handler for extra safety.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New refinements confirmed working on both standalone HTML and React root: (a) Whyst0 font embedded and applied to zeros in output (.z0 in standalone, .tk-zero in React), (b) column pair rows are centered with visible gap on both sides (not flush to ticket right edge), (c) ASTEO header has letter-spacing:4px. PDF A4 export still functional on both surfaces. Long provenance / nCamion does not cause overflow. For font.check assertions on Whyst0, always await document.fonts.ready and call document.fonts.load('12px Whyst0') first to ensure the data-URL @font-face is materialized.
